courses.title: Reading Methods
courses.course_description: HUM 100 introduces students to a variety of source material, scholarly and literary, in the Humanities, and teaches them how to read academic books and articles critically for research into specific, student-chosen topics. The course also aims to give students facility in accessing and effectively employing library resources and developing bibliographic methods. Theme/Topic of the course will vary depending on who is teaching it. Students may be required to visit off-campus sites, such as the Newberry Library or the Art Institute of Chicago.
